description: This file defines the Option controller class in the OpenCart admin module for managing product options, including listing, creating, editing, deleting, and autocompleting options.

classes.name: Option
classes.description: Controller class for managing product options in the OpenCart admin interface.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main options management page with breadcrumb navigation and sub-controllers.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a list of options with sorting and pagination.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing an option.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving a new or existing option based on submitted data.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes selected options after permission and association checks.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for options based on filter input.
